source: Built by hand from /opt/repos/sunspot/marketing/reel-studio/publish-ad.mjs (createCreative L168-187, createImageCreative L200-217, the PAUSED ad create L284-289, the swap L270-275) with its default CFG for Sunspot, 2026-10-17. Its --dry-run output is cut at 400 characters, so the bodies are reconstructed from the code. Placeholders in angle brackets are values that only exist at run time.
allowedDifferences: name: the plugin uses the deterministic {BRAND}-{campaign}-{format}-{yyyymmdd}-{hash6} name instead of 'Aurinkopulssi reel/kuva <date>'
UTM: the plugin's final URL adds the brand template's extra parameters (utm_content) to utm_source=meta&utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign
video thumbnail: image_url (the poster or Meta's /{video}/thumbnails URI) instead of image_hash of an ffmpeg frame
image media: link_data.picture (the media URL, G4) instead of image_hash of an adimages upload
